name: smwmusic-touhou-gensoukyou-lotus-land-story-gensokyo-lotus-land-story-remix
title: Touhou Gensoukyou ~ Lotus Land Story - Gensokyo ~ Lotus Land Story (Remix)
description:
Did a remix of Gensokyo ~ Lotus Land Story, the title theme of Touhou 4: Lotus Land Story.

This can work with title screens, but it can also work for sky / athletic levels, night levels, intense moments, & even boss fights.

Note:
There's a text file with the sample group in which you'll have to move it into your sample group text file.
There are three customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song file:
- d minor (The default pitch)
- c# minor (The alternate pitch)
- f minor (A custom pitch for this remix)
